source:
@@U01924@@
(In chorus.)

@@U01925@@
Their magic salve makes witches hale,
And any old rag will do for a sail,
Any old tub can fly through the sky,
You either fly now, or you'll never fly.

@@U01927@@
(In chorus.)

@@U01928@@
And when we've sailed around, around
The peak, then sweep along the ground,
And scour the heath to its farthest reaches
With endless swarms of lowering witches.

@@U01929@@
(They alight.)

@@U01931@@
They jammer and jolt, they jabber and justle,
They whiz and whirl, babble and bustle,
They flash and spark, stink, and burn,
And all things topsy-turvy turn!
The truly hurly-burly which is
Mother's milk to hovering witches!
Stick close to me now
or well be swept apart.
Where are you?

@@U01933@@
(In the distance.)

@@U01934@@
Here!

@@U01936@@
What, dragged off so far already?
I guess [’ll have to show them who’s master here.
Make way!
Squire Nick is coming through!
Make way there, make way, good people!
—Here, Doctor, hold on tight!
One grand leap and we're free of this mob
that’s too wild even for me.
translation:
@@U01924@@
（齐声）

@@U01925@@
他们的神奇药膏使女巫变得坚强，
任何旧布都可以用来做帆，
任何旧浴缸都可以飞上天空，
你要么现在就飞，要么永远不会飞。

@@U01927@@
（齐声）

@@U01928@@
当我们四处航行时
顶峰，然后扫过地面，
并把荒野搜寻到最远的地方
伴随着无尽的低等女巫群。

@@U01929@@
（他们下了车。）

@@U01931@@
他们干扰和震动，他们叽叽喳喳和吵闹，
它们呼啸而旋转，喋喋不休，喧闹，
它们闪烁、火花、发臭、燃烧，
一切都天翻地覆！
真正的喧嚣是
给盘旋女巫的母乳！
现在就靠近我
或者我们会被扫地出门。
你在哪里？

@@U01933@@
（在远处。）

@@U01934@@
在这里！

@@U01936@@
怎么，已经拖这么远了？
我想[必须让他们知道谁才是这里的主人。
让路！
乡绅尼克来了！
让路，让路，好人们！
——来了，博士，抓紧了！
一大步，我们就摆脱了这帮暴徒
即使对我来说这也太疯狂了。
